Card Q&A.a: Yes, it activates at the end of the battle, regardless of outcome.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [Security] effect activate even if it loses the battle against the attacking Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: This Digimon’s [Security] effect activates after the battle with the attacking Digimon ends, and before the next check is performed.
Card Q&A.q: This card is flipped over during a security check, but the attacking Digimon still has security checks remaining. Does this Digimon’s effect activate first, or do I have to wait until my opponent finishes the rest of their security checks?

Effect: [Security] At the end of the battle, trigger ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ on 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash 1 card from the top of one of your opponent's Digimon. If it has no digivolution cards, or becomes a level 3 Digimon, you can't trash any more cards.)
